The site is Meadowbrook Wildlife Hospital — Volunteer Onboarding & Credentials, a onboarding-auth web application for Wildlife rehabilitation volunteer intake and credentials.

Owner brief: "Our regional wildlife rehabilitation hospital needs an onboarding portal for prospective volunteers. Applicants should register with contact details, specify vaccination status and handling experience, and create a volunteer login. The server must securely persist application state so volunteers can log back in later and see their approval status."

Locale & copy conventions (en-GB): Use £ prices, British English spelling, day-month dates and .co.uk-style invented domains. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-05/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Meadowbrook Wildlife Hospital — Volunteer Onboarding & Credentials: the page for wildlife rehabilitation volunteer intake and credentials, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #14532d (wb-green), #22c55e (wb-leaf), #f0fdf4 (wb-light), #cbd5e1 (wb-border), #0f172a (wb-dark), #ffffff (wb-card). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 10px, content-frame 1100px, control-border 1px solid var(--wb-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a credential field without an autocomplete token; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Meadowbrook Wildlife Hospital — Volunteer Onboarding & Credentials as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a group of fields (3 of them), then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Volunteer full name", "Email address", "Emergency phone number", "Account password", "Vaccination status", "Wildlife handling experience", "Preferred wildlife focus", "Handling background and certifications").

User journey context: Fill out the multi-field volunteer onboarding form with contact and experience details. Submit registration credentials and view the pending onboarding confirmation page. Log out and log back in to review the stored volunteer profile information.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
